sceneTitle: Rupture: St. Kitts und Nevis Collides with Sortimentstiefe
startFrameReason: Major composition change to a new photographed Kaufhaus zone showing rupture.
prompt: The green plant-monster in a Kaufhaus flooded with endless multiplying shelves of assorted goods; limbs wildly stretched shielding; flickering lamps; overwhelmed visitors; chaotic fluorescent green lighting; medium close-up; forward camera push; 1989 BRD style. The Sortimentstiefe introduces overwhelming multiplicity that fractures the tropical warmth, flooding the room and destabilizing all present. The monster attempts to shield the Kaufhaus from the chaotic flood of goods by wildly stretching its limbs to contain the space. The Kaufhaus is flooded with multiplying shelves and assorted goods; lamps flicker erratically; visitors appear overwhelmed; the space feels chaotic and fractured.
